criteria.name: Client interview and fact development
criteria.description: Conducts a humane, effective client-intake interview and develops the facts from records and witnesses into a reliable chronology of the three failures.

subcriteria.name: Interview technique and rapport
subcriteria.description: Uses open-ended then focused questions, builds rapport, follows up on hints, and surfaces the client's guarded and undisclosed facts without pressure or flattery.

subcriteria.name: Records synthesis and chronology
subcriteria.description: Synthesizes the case-file documents and witness statements into an accurate timeline and identifies gaps and conflicts.

criteria.name: Warranty and remedies analysis
criteria.description: Correctly analyzes the express and implied warranties, the limited repair-or-replace remedy and its possible failure of essential purpose, and the enforceability of the consequential-damages exclusion.

subcriteria.name: Warranties and breach elements
subcriteria.description: Identifies the governing sale-of-goods warranties and the elements of the co-op's breach claim and Brandt's defenses.

subcriteria.name: Limited remedy and consequential-damages exclusion
subcriteria.description: Analyzes failure of essential purpose and whether the consequential-damages exclusion survives, applying law to the disputed facts.

criteria.name: Remedies, damages, and causation strategy
criteria.description: Frames the dispositive issues, addresses the mixed-causation problem candidly, and builds a realistic damages and remedy theory.

criteria.name: ADR strategy and client counseling
criteria.description: Counsels the co-op on mediation versus binding arbitration, assesses the co-op's best alternative and settlement posture, and gives a candid recommendation.

criteria.name: Professional responsibility and written communication
criteria.description: Observes the Rule 4.2 no-contact limit with the represented opposing party and communicates clearly, in facts-and-advice form, without improper citation of law to the client.
